evidence: The nanostructured TiO2 electrodes were fabricated on stainless steel discs (15.5 mm ø) where a gold layer is sputtered to facilitate TMV self-assembly. The nickel-coated TMV core was synthesized as previously described followed by ALD coating of a 20 nm thick TiO2 layer (details in the Supplementary Information). Finally, the electrodes were annealed in air at 450 1C for 3 h to facilitate formation of anatase phase which has been suggested as the most facile lithium ion intercalation host among the various polymorphs of TiO2.
